required_fixes: Obtain official Mind2Web test_website and test_domain splits from an alternative source (dataset author backup, HuggingFace revision with 3-way splits, or archived parquet) and record dataset_revision hash; do not fabricate synthetic 60/40 website shuffle (falsifier clause spec.json: MEASUREMENT_INVALID if official splits unavailable). Re-run TF-IDF->kmeans train-only pipeline on train vs official test_website (C1) and test_domain (C2) to obtain valid delta and p vs 1000 website-label shuffles.

Obtain WebArena-Verified v2 data via alternative substrate (GitHub raw task dumps, Docker image extraction, or census artifact reuse from EXP-INTEL-35697055679/35725763380) to perform family-level holdout (20% families, 5 folds) for C3; do not compute cross-store overlap as 0.0 (spec vacuous null on single store). Document family definitions and verify TF-IDF fitted train-only per fold.

Recompute full 1000-shuffle null per k (k, k/2, 2k) with per-shuffle refit of TF-IDF+kmeans on shuffled-train only and transform+predict on shuffled-test; report null mean, std, p95, and one-sided p=(1+#{null>=observed})/1001. Current 100-shuffle proxy degenerate (mean 1.0 std 0.0) is not a valid decision null and must be replaced; do not interpret proxy delta.

Re-enable positive control POS-WITHIN-SAME-WEBSITE (split single large website 50/50) and null control NULL-INDEPENDENT-DOMAINS (travel vs shopping or random tokens) with same train-only code path and 1000-shuffle null; both currently UNKNOWN. Controls must pass frozen thresholds (POS overlap >=0.50 delta>=0.20 p<0.01; NC delta<=0.05 p>0.10) before any C1/C2/C3 verdict is adopted. Also compute B-SITE-LEAKAGE, B-RANDOM-SPLIT, B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP as preregistered.

validity_findings.finding: Proxy website-label shuffle null (100 shuffles) is degenerate: mean 1.0 p95 1.0 std 0.0. This occurs because with only one observed split (train) the k-means assignment inevitably covers all test clusters (overlap=|C_train∩C_test|/|C_test| always 1.0). Demonstrates why official holdout splits are necessary to obtain a non-degenerate null where test may contain novel clusters. Producer correctly interprets this as confirmation that null cannot be estimated without holdout structure, not as evidence delta=0.

claim_ceiling: No claim about C-CROSSSITE supported or falsified by this experiment. Maximum justified: the TF-IDF->k-means train-only pipeline is operational (k=50 vocab 1655 50 clusters max fraction 10.7% no collapse, clean text leak-free) but MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to substrate unavailability: osunlp/Mind2Web revision 17ece8... provides only train (1009 tasks 73 websites) vs required train/test_website/test_domain; web-arena/web-arena-verified 404. The degenerate proxy null (mean 1.0 p95 1.0) confirms holdout overlap cannot be measured without official splits. Therefore C-CROSSSITE remains HYPOTHESIS with ceiling bounded to census-level parameterized family reuse (WebArena 192 tasks 49 templates duplication 0.9479 per EXP-INTEL-35697055679, Mind2Web 1009/73 vs spec 137/31) and documentation-level structural candidacy (EXP-INTEL-35651934683 inflated M1), not measured transfer. No delta, p, or overlap_observed for C1/C2/C3 is valid; WebArena family holdout unmeasured; Mind2Web delta unknown. Infrastructure failure is not falsification.
